fullContentHtml:
UPTET 2026 Certificate - Complete Details

Short Details :Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the Certificate for the Uttar Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test (UPTET) 2026. Applications for the UPTET Online Form 2026 were accepted from 27 March 2026 to 03 May 2026. The UPTET examination was conducted on 02, 03, and 04 July 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UPTET Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 March 2026
  • Last Date : 03 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 03 May 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 08 May 2026
  • Complete Form/ Submit Date : Available Now
  • Exam Date : 2, 3, & 4 July 2026
  • Exam City Details : 22 June 2026
  • Admit Card : 30 June 2026
  • Answer Key : 08 July 2026
  • Result : 26 August 2026
  • Certificate : 07 September 2026

Application Fee

  • Fees For Single Paper
  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 500/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 300/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
